The armadagroupco.com domain itself is a corporate/brand-portfolio site with no working cart (collections/all is empty, no /products/ pages), so gate 4 would normally fail on this domain. However, Armada Retail Concept is the confirmed developer/operator (same Apple App Store developer account, 'Armada Retail Concept Apps') of the Riva Fashion app, which shows 500K+ installs on Google Play -- well past the 50k+ rescue threshold -- so the account qualifies via app-download rescue regardless of gates 2-5a.

WebSearch: 'Armada Retail Concept is a well-recognized franchise operator... headquarters based in Kuwait... retail history in the region since 1973' and Apple App Store developer page 'Armada Retail Concept Apps' lists the Riva Fashion app. Direct fetch of Google Play listing (play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.armada.riva) shows '500K+' under 'Downloads'.
